e.title: hardhat (CAS)
e.summary: 工人补偿费率计算 Python 包（CAS 官方）：CAS Exam 8 算法（Table M/追溯/经验费率）转代码
e.body:
hardhat 是 CAS 官方维护的 Python 包：把 CAS Exam 8 教材中的工人补偿（workers' compensation）计算算法转成代码——从 Table M 构建开始（经典增额损失比率方法），后续覆盖追溯费率与经验费率。CI/codecov 完备。对 RIAA：备考 CAS 考试 + 学工人补偿费率算法的配套实现（把真题算法跑起来）。与 [[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]]（Wüthrich 经验费率）、[[claim-frequency]]（DAV 定价）、[[insurancerating]]（费率工具）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]。

e.summary_en: Workers'-compensation rating Python package (CAS official): converts CAS Exam 8 algorithms (Table M/retro/experience rating) into code
e.summary_hk: 工人補償費率計算 Python 包（CAS 官方）：CAS Exam 8 算法（Table M/追溯/經驗費率）轉代碼
e.body_en:
hardhat is a CAS-official Python package: it converts the workers'-compensation calculation algorithms from the CAS Exam 8 material into code — starting with Table M construction (the classic increased-limits-ratio method), then retroactive and experience rating. CI/codecov complete. For RIAA: a companion implementation for CAS-exam preparation and learning workers'-comp rating algorithms (run the exam algorithms). Complements [[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]] (Wüthrich experience rating), [[claim-frequency]] (DAV pricing) and [[insurancerating]] (rating tools). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]].
